name: Interactive Glyph Placement for Tensor Fields
definition: An iterative glyph packing algorithm for tensor fields that uses a Delaunay triangulation acceleration structure to speed up clustering and neighborhood searches, avoiding re-computation when planes move through a volume.
summary: Interactive Glyph Placement for Tensor Fields is an iterative algorithm that densely distributes glyphs to minimize overlap while preserving tensor information, distinguished by its use of Delaunay triangulation for real-time interactive exploration.
